title: Scheduled financial reports intake and prioritization rules for enterprise console
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Problem: Several enterprise customers (banking, healthcare SaaS, and a retail marketplace) have requested first-class, scheduled exports of usage and cost data from the Console. Current one-off CSV downloads are insufficient: customers need automated daily/weekly exports, per-team and per-route cost breakdowns, and formats compatible with internal chargeback systems (CSV/Parquet).

Scope: This ticket captures intake, triage, and prioritization rules for a new 'Scheduled Financial Reports' capability. The feature should allow org admins to configure recurring exports that include: aggregated cost by model/route/token, per-team or tag filters, user-level attribution where available, and both raw events and summarized billing-friendly rows. Exports must meet enterprise security expectations (KMS encryption, VPC/S3 endpoints, signed URL rotation) and provide audit logs for compliance.

Constraints & non-goals: We will not ship an immediate full billing pipeline rewrite here. This effort focuses on export UX + job orchestration + secure delivery. Deeper billing model changes and invoice-level reconciliation are out of scope and will be tracked separately.

Why this matters: Customers are using external BI tools for chargebacks and forecasting; inability to schedule and secure exports is blocking sales in regulated accounts and increasing manual support load.

Proposal summary: Build a scheduled export subsystem in Console: UI to configure exports, backend job scheduler, S3/GS signed delivery + optional webhook push, RBAC & audit, and an export schema that supports token-level and aggregated cost rows. Prioritize implementation for customers with committed spend and compliance requirements, with a clear launch path for general availability.
acceptance_criteria: Org admins can create a scheduled export with cadence options: daily/weekly/monthly and custom cron up to once per day
Export supports CSV and Parquet formats and includes both raw event rows and summarized billing rows
Filters: by team/tag/route/model/date-range; exports can be scoped to a single project or entire org
Exports are delivered to a customer-managed S3/GCS bucket with server-side encryption or via encrypted pre-signed URL with configurable TTL
Audit trail created for export creation, edits, deliveries, and failures visible in Console and accessible via API
Delivery SLA: job enqueue within 2 minutes of schedule, and retry logic for transient failures with exponential backoff; failure notifications to org admin
Data retention and schema versioning documented and compatible with downstream chargeback workflows
Security review completed and documented; KMS integration validated for one pilot customer
End-to-end test for a pilot customer showing correct per-team cost breakdown and successful secure delivery
notes: Stakeholder requests collected from: Acme Financial (security team), MediHealth (compliance), and RetailCo (platform ops)
Sales reports 6 live deals stalled pending secure scheduled exports and SSO + audit logs
Suggested priority scoring: committed ARR (> $100k) + regulatory need (HIPAA/PCI) + operational impact (# support escalations)
Design asked for a simple 'Create scheduled export' wizard with preview of sample rows and a dry-run option
Legal flagged retention and PII concerns — will follow up with a data minimization checklist
Proposed initial schema v1: event_timestamp, org_id, project_id, team_id, route, model, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, token_cost_usd, sdk_call_id (nullable)
